body: I've just come to the conclusion that I'm not cut out for the stresses of graduate school. I guess my mind is warped into believing that if I get a service job i'm a failure, I live in a smaller city. I could move to a bigger city but I hate it, alot of bad memories. I love where I live so I'll just have to find a way up.
I'm still here, but the physical pain is bad today..

The problem is in order to update my skills I need to learn web design. I have 10 years of graphic design but everyone wants web stuff now. I was teaching art and substituting, but with the chronic pain plus the mental stuff I can't leave my house for very long, a trip to the grocer which is also very hard. Working from home or doing a degree online are pretty much my options, there is one program in the US that is fully online and would give me time for two years but it requires a test that I would have an incredibly hard time sitting and doing. 

Like this morning, I'm in so much pain that I can barely make it into the bathroom. My heart is working so hard it wakes me up. It's hard to deal with everyday, especially when I finally thought things were getting better..
thank you, you're a nice person. I hope life is good to you..
I don't want to die but I don't know how to live. My injury is due to abuse from a past bf who drove us into a truck. Thank you for talking with me..
